The '''Battle of Loedorvia''' was part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] assault on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Believing that terrorizing civilian populations was the essence of war,<ref name="TEGW" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] released the [[Brainrot Plague]] during the battle.<ref name="TEA" /> The plague spread through the entire [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]], killing all the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Army/Legends|armies]] and nearly every [[Human/Legends|Human]] in the sector.<ref name="RotSICS" />

==Aftermath==
The plague left the Weemell sector temporarily uninhabitable.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The release of the Brainrot Plague, together with actions such as the [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|bombardment]] of [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], horrified Core Worlders.<ref name="TEA" /> Amongst the Separatists there was also division on the use of [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]]. [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] feared that use of such weapons might fuel [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]], whilst leaders like [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] considered it insulting towards [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], as they were often victims of plagues and diseases.<ref name="TEGW" />
